vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately identify which HelioGrid product is the sole campaign product; specifically, HelioGrid Flex?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if the complete name “HelioGrid Flex” is explicit and no second HelioGrid product is promoted.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if “Flex” is unmistakable but the brand prefix is omitted.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if Flex is absent, another product is primary, or another HelioGrid product is co-featured.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately identify which reporting region controls the campaign; specifically, Central?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if Central is explicit as the campaign region.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the content is clearly Central-program specific but the region name itself is omitted.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if another region is named, the campaign is generic/national, or Central cannot be inferred.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately identify which flexible-load track won the post-selection routing calculation; specifically, The Level 2 EV-charger track, not the heat-pump track or a combined EV-or-heat-pump audience?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if the campaign explicitly targets qualifying Level 2 EV charging and excludes heat-pump or combined alternatives.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if EV charging is clearly primary and heat-pump language is only incidental.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if EV and heat pump are presented as co-equal alternatives, the track is generic flexible loads, or heat pump is selected.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately identify which utility program is selected inside the winning EV track; specifically, LoneStar FlexCharge?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if LoneStar FlexCharge is explicit.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if LoneStar is explicit but the full program name is shortened without ambiguity.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the program is absent, generic, or another utility program is named.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what current campaign label is shown; specifically, Central EV Solar Conversion Pilot?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if “Central EV Solar Conversion Pilot” or a semantically exact equivalent is shown.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the label retains Central, EV, and solar-conversion pilot meaning but is mildly shortened.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if EV is omitted, a generic Central conversion label is used, or another track/objective appears.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what complete leadership badge is shown; specifically, May 2026 Central EV-Track Program-Eligible Net-Contribution Leader?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if May 2026, Central, EV-Track, Program-Eligible, Net-Contribution, and Leader are all present.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if exactly one non-period qualifier is omitted.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if two or more components are missing, the track/region is wrong, or a generic sales/revenue badge is used.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show the current EV-track lead benefit as follows: Coordinate rooftop solar with qualifying Level 2 charging during participating utility event windows, with normal charging schedules outside events?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if the message is specifically about qualifying Level 2 charging during utility event windows and normal charging outside events.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the EV-charging/event-window purpose is clear but one timing qualifier is omitted.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the copy remains generic flexible-load language, includes heat-pump alternatives, or changes the objective.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what installer-set EV proof point is used; specifically, Installer-set EV charging profiles align rooftop-solar input with a compatible Level 2 charger?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if the proof is specifically about installer-set EV charging profiles and a compatible Level 2 charger.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the EV-profile meaning is clear but either installer-set or compatible is omitted.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if heat pumps are offered as an alternative, the proof is generic, or another proof role is used.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what app-status proof point is used; specifically, App event status shows when charging timing is active and when the normal charging schedule resumes?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if both active charging timing and normal charging-schedule resumption are explicit.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if active-and-resume timing is clear but charging is described only generically.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if either active status or schedule resumption is absent, or another app claim is used.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what action is the viewer asked to take; specifically, Check LoneStar EV-flex eligibility?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the CTA explicitly asks to check LoneStar EV-flex eligibility.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if it asks to check Central EV eligibility but omits the program name.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if EV is omitted, the CTA is a generic conversion-pilot check, waitlist, purchase, quote, or learn-more action.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what household base is named in the qualification; specifically, Owner-occupied Central rooftop-solar homes?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if owner-occupied, Central, and rooftop-solar are all explicit.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if exactly one of those three qualifiers is omitted.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if two or more are omitted or the audience is renter, apartment, commercial, another region, or generic national.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what equipment configuration is required; specifically, A compatible inverter pathway and a verified qualifying Level 2 EV charger?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if both the compatible inverter pathway and verified qualifying Level 2 EV charger are explicit.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if exactly one equipment qualifier is incomplete or if a heat-pump alternative remains alongside the EV charger.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the EV charger is absent, another track is selected, or both equipment conditions are missing.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what utility-program participation is required; specifically, The home must be in a participating LoneStar FlexCharge territory?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if participating LoneStar FlexCharge territory is explicit.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if participating LoneStar territory is clear but the full program name is shortened.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the program is absent, generic participating-utility language is used, or another utility program is named.

vqa_items.state: Does the image state that outcomes are not guaranteed; specifically, Energy-cost and charging outcomes are not guaranteed?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if the no-guarantee statement covers both energy-cost and charging outcomes.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if a clear no-guarantee statement appears but only one outcome type is named.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the no-guarantee meaning is absent or a guaranteed result is implied.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately identify which factors are stated to affect outcomes; specifically, Solar production, vehicle charging demand, utility event frequency, and installer settings?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if all four factors are explicit.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if exactly one factor is missing or vehicle charging demand is replaced by generic household demand.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if two or more factors are missing or only a generic results-vary statement appears.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what geographic availability limitation is stated; specifically, Eligible LoneStar FlexCharge territories in TX only, with availability potentially differing within the state?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if TX-only LoneStar territory scope and within-state variation are explicit.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if TX and within-state variation are present but the program name is omitted, or if LoneStar and TX are present but the variation condition is omitted.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if additional states are presented as current, TX is absent, or statewide/universal availability is implied.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what enrollment and site-review conditions apply before activation; specifically, Utility enrollment and an installer site review are required before activation?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if both utility enrollment and installer site review are required before activation.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if exactly one prerequisite is stated with the correct timing.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if both are absent or the timing is wrong.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what charger-specific verification is required before activation; specifically, Compatible Level 2 charger verification is required before activation?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if charger verification and before-activation timing are explicit.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if charger verification is present but the timing is unclear.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if charger verification is absent or another device is verified instead.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what may happen to charging timing during utility events; specifically, Charging timing may change during utility event windows?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if charging-timing change during utility event windows is explicit.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if generic flexible-load timing change is stated without charging specificity.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the timing-change meaning or event-window condition is absent.

vqa_items.state: Does the image accurately show what customer override consequence is disclosed; specifically, Customers can override an event, and overriding may reduce program benefits?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if both override permission and possible reduced program benefits are explicit.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if override is allowed but the consequence is omitted, or the consequence is stated without clear override permission.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if both meanings are absent or override is disallowed.

vqa_items.state: Does the campaign use the approved residential background role; specifically, A detached Central residential home with a recognizable rooftop-solar array?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if a detached residential rooftop-solar home compatible with the Central source is clearly used.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if a detached rooftop-solar home is clear but regional source identity is uncertain.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the setting is apartment, commercial, non-solar, wrong-region, or absent.

vqa_items.state: Is a single current HelioGrid Flex conversion enclosure used as the product hero; specifically, One current wall-mounted Flex conversion enclosure is identifiable; no second product or schematic substitutes for it?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if one current wall-mounted Flex enclosure is clearly isolated as the product hero.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if a wall-mounted conversion enclosure is present but exact Flex identity is uncertain.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the product is absent, another product is used, multiple devices compete, or a schematic/reference image substitutes for the hero.

vqa_items.state: Are readable supplier or third-party marks removed from the product source; specifically, so that no readable supplier name, third-party brand, warning label, or test label remains?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if none of those marks or labels is readable.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if one minor non-readable remnant remains.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if any supplier/third-party brand, warning label, or test label is readable.

vqa_items.state: Are exposed connectors and loose leads removed; specifically, so that no exposed connector or loose lead remains on or around the product enclosure?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if no exposed connector or loose lead is visible.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if one minor ambiguous cable remnant remains.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if exposed connectors or loose leads are clearly visible.

vqa_items.state: Are unrelated equipment and reference-room context removed; specifically, so that no unrelated panel, instrument, engineering-room context, or uncropped reference-frame content remains?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if the enclosure is isolated without unrelated equipment or room/reference context.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if one minor ambiguous background remnant remains.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if unrelated equipment or substantial engineering-room/reference framing is visible.

vqa_items.state: Does the image avoid unsupported claims and internal values or identifiers; specifically, so that no unsupported guarantee, universal-control/availability claim, price/savings/capacity/warranty claim, internal amount, calculation, customer detail, ID, key, code, or workbook field is visible; the approved badge metric wording without a number is allowed?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 if all prohibited claims and internal values/identifiers are absent.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if no number, guarantee, calculation, or sensitive identifier is exposed but one harmless internal-sounding fragment remains.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if any unsupported numerical/guaranteed claim, internal amount/calculation, customer detail, ID/key/code, or workbook field is visible.

vqa_items.state: As a customer-facing social campaign creative, does the image fuse the selected subject or product, audience-relevant setting, campaign message, approved benefit or proof, brand identity, and CTA into one distinctive, platform-native, highly polished feed composition?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the creative is exceptional and ready for campaign deployment: the subject or product is unmistakably dominant; setting, message, proof, brand, and CTA reinforce one another in a single coherent concept; the crop feels native to the intended feed placement; essential text is readable at feed size; and imagery, typography, color, spacing, and finish are distinctive, premium, and meticulously controlled. No generic campaign template, weak subject focus, disconnected proof, competing copy, detached CTA, awkward crop, malformed text, or rendering flaw is allowed. Any meaningful campaign-quality concern prevents 2.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the creative is coherent, usable, and visually decent or attractive, but it remains ordinary or visibly imperfect—for example, generic styling, modest product or destination focus, disconnected proof points, competing copy, a weak CTA, or a slightly awkward crop.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 even when campaign elements are present if the output looks poor or fails to cohere: subject, setting, message, proof, brand, and CTA feel disconnected; focal hierarchy is weak; text or crop is badly handled; or the composition requires substantial redesign before use. Blank, corrupted, severely unreadable, or broken creatives are also 0.
